rules.statement: In order to establish that the vendor had no shadow of title to the property conveyed, a very high standard of proof was required.
rules.supporting_quote: "While I have some sympathy for the respondent, I consider that he has fallen short of proving that his vendor had 'no shadow of a title' to the property conveyed. It seems that in order to bring a party within the benefits of the exception referred to in the above case, a very high standard of proof is required and that it is not sufficient merely to adduce a situation from which it might be suspected or inferred that the vendor's title was unsound."
